seoTitle: Video Speed Changer: Slow Motion and Time-Lapse in a Browser
metaDescription: Make a video slower or faster, from 0.0625x to 16x, with or without audio. Real-time browser recording, no upload.
intro: Plays a video faster or slower and records the result. Choose a factor between 0.0625 and 16 and keep or drop the audio.
why:
Speed change here is done by playing the video at the new rate and recording the screen output. That means the browser limits (0.0625x to 16x) apply, and a clip played at 2x takes half its length to record.

Nothing is uploaded. The file is decoded by your browser and re-encoded, so quality drops a little and the result is WebM (or MP4 where your browser can record it). With audio kept, the browser keeps the pitch where it can.
howTo: Enter the speed factor. Use 0.25 for slow motion or 8 for time-lapse.
Choose whether to keep the audio.

faq.a: Browsers do not allow a higher playback rate.
It repeats frames, it does not invent new ones, so very slow results can look steppy.

faq.q: What about the sound at high speed?
faq.a: It may be unclear. Drop the audio for time-lapse.
The length of the output, because it is recorded as it plays.
